verdict.rationale: Cua documents two ways for an agent to work behind logins. A signed-in app such as Chrome or Slack can be moved into a Space and stays signed in, and an agent can be allowed to sign in to a site with a saved password. Saved items stay locked until the operator approves access, and sensitive items require Touch ID. Neither source says outright that passwords are kept out of the model's context or its logs, so the core protection is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that credentials are injected without reaching the model, log/audit redaction of secrets, independent or hands-on corroboration of the credential flow.
